CROSS-REFERENCE — provenance. This removal came out of the 2026-08-12 deprecation removal-readiness survey, originally written up on childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet (comment 11) — a scratchpad placement the operator has since ruled an anti-pattern. Survey summary now in session log cosey-vinegarish-mouflon (d0d8-9dfe-f2d8-4364), entry 2.

The survey's load-bearing scoping finding for this item: removal is much smaller than it looks, because the single-pass ENGINE _review_ticket_impl must STAY — it has three live internal consumers (src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:92-95, src/rebar/llm/review_workflows.py:86, src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:348). Removal therefore deletes only three thin public entry points: the warn-and-delegate wrapper (llm/operations.py:135-183), the CLI intercept (_cli/__init__.py:513 + _llm_commands.py:133), and the MCP tool (_mcp_llm.py:61). schemas/review_result.schema.json also stays — it is still the engine's output contract. Surface area at survey time: 42 non-impl refs in src, 24 in docs, 19 test files. The survey rated this NOT YET on schedule (remove_in=v1.0.0, deprecated 8 days earlier and shipped in the current release) and named it the strongest candidate for a third pre-1.0 breaking window — which is the operator ruling this ticket then executed under.
